changes.reason: Ambessa has been too reliable in her late game output for players with high mastery in all brackets, but especially pro-play.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Ambessa has been too reliable in her late game output for players with high mastery in all brackets, but especially pro-play.

changes.reason: Ashe is one of the premier marksmen in pro play at the moment, and we're seeing her output too much raw damage given her position as the highest utility marksman in the game.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Ashe is one of the premier marksmen in pro play at the moment, and we're seeing her output too much raw damage given her position as the highest utility marksman in the game.

changes.reason: Our changes two patches ago to Cassiopeia have been pretty good directionally, with most players being proportionally less impacted from those adjustments than pros.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Our changes two patches ago to Cassiopeia have been pretty good directionally, with most players being proportionally less impacted from those adjustments than pros.

changes.reason: While Diana's assassin build shines, her bruiser builds tend to be lagging a good bit behind.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: While Diana's assassin build shines, her bruiser builds tend to be lagging a good bit behind.

changes.reason: Stacking the odds a bit more in his favor with his signature spell (in Riftbound) and offsetting Rocketbelt changes that he'll be a bit less excited about.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Stacking the odds a bit more in his favor with his signature spell (in Riftbound) and offsetting Rocketbelt changes that he'll be a bit less excited about.

changes.reason: Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs in areas that won't make them much more overwhelming in early invades.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs in areas that won't make them much more overwhelming in early invades.

changes.reason: Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play - hurting early mana and consistent W damage reduction, which should be skewed for elite audiences.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play - hurting early mana and consistent W damage reduction, which should be skewed for elite audiences.

changes.reason: Last patch we looked to inject a bit more power into the deer, but didn't quite see the movement we were looking for.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Last patch we looked to inject a bit more power into the deer, but didn't quite see the movement we were looking for.

changes.reason: Last patch's adjustment to help normalize mid and bot performance ended up landing as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff to make up for the lost power.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Last patch's adjustment to help normalize mid and bot performance ended up landing as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff to make up for the lost power.

changes.reason: Windows between Mordekaiser's ultimates make it hard to keep up with the pace of much of his opposition.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Windows between Mordekaiser's ultimates make it hard to keep up with the pace of much of his opposition.

changes.reason: Rocketbelt's adjustment this patch will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko, so we're giving her some minor compensation
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Rocketbelt's adjustment this patch will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko, so we're giving her some minor compensation

changes.reason: Smolder has lost quite a bit of power over the last few patches, with the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot lane meta changes disfavoring him significantly.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Smolder has lost quite a bit of power over the last few patches, with the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot lane meta changes disfavoring him significantly.

changes.reason: We're giving Swain mid a moderate buff this patch while also making an adjustment that should help normalize his mid and bot lane performance.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: We're giving Swain mid a moderate buff this patch while also making an adjustment that should help normalize his mid and bot lane performance.

changes.reason: As one of the tank supports with the lowest health regen, and many health scaling values on his abilities, Tahm Kench lost out on the recent adjustments to the support item.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: As one of the tank supports with the lowest health regen, and many health scaling values on his abilities, Tahm Kench lost out on the recent adjustments to the support item.

changes.reason: Vayne has settled into a fairly weak spot, and while we still aren't totally happy with her top vs bot skew, we're getting closer.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Vayne has settled into a fairly weak spot, and while we still aren't totally happy with her top vs bot skew, we're getting closer.

changes.reason: Yunara is the leading candidate for "handshake hyperscaler do nothing" and we want to avoid that becoming the dominant meta, especially heading into worlds.
changes.riotStatement: Riot's intent: Yunara is the leading candidate for "handshake hyperscaler do nothing" and we want to avoid that becoming the dominant meta, especially heading into worlds.
details: Slow Stacking: Stacks with other slows ⇒ No longer stacks with other slows

changes.reason: Sundered Sky nerfs indirectly cost Aatrox power, so Riot restored some durability and uptime.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Aatrox lost power from Sundered Sky changes and is getting a bump.
details: W cooldown reduced at early ranks.
E healing from bonus health increased.

changes.reason: Riot wanted to improve an underperforming hypercarry in an enchanter-friendly meta.
changes.riotStatement: Riot describes this as a broad boost to help Aphelios step back into the spotlight.

changes.reason: Rocketbelt nerfs left Aurora weaker, so Riot added waveclear and ultimate outplay power.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Aurora is receiving more waveclear and ultimate outplay potential.

changes.reason: Bot-lane role quest gold reduced the relative value of Draven's Adoration advantage.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is tapping up Draven's early-game damage.
details: Base attack damage increased from 62 to 64.

changes.reason: Elise had been weak compared with stronger AP junglers.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is helping Elise's clear speed and damage.

changes.reason: Riot wanted Fiora to be rewarded more after successfully finding an opening.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Fiora has room to shine more after succeeding in a fight.
details: R heal range and healing increased.

changes.reason: Kha'Zix was only on the fringe of the jungle meta after Sundered Sky users fell back.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is buffing weaker evolves to increase Kha'Zix's flexibility.

changes.reason: Riot wanted more survivability and stronger playmaking at higher levels.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is helping Lillia's durability and making her ultimate more rewarding.

changes.reason: Power shifted away from Vigilance and into Q to rebalance mid and bot Lucian.
changes.riotStatement: Riot describes this as retuning Vigilance while giving power elsewhere.

changes.reason: A previous Rageblade interaction hurt Yi more than other users, so his Q cooldown refund penalty was removed.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says this should mostly help non-SR modes but is still a mechanical buff.
details: Q on-hit cooldown refund no longer scales down with ability haste.

changes.reason: Nasus was becoming too reliable at reaching strong stacking breakpoints.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says higher highs are being offset by lower early-game power.

changes.reason: Nocturne remained strong in both pro and solo queue.
changes.riotStatement: Riot targets his map presence by increasing ultimate cooldown.

changes.reason: Riot wanted to reduce Poppy's jungle flex strength and counterpick pressure.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is reverting a previous jungle-clear buff.

changes.reason: High-level lane power was reduced while jungle compensation was added.
changes.riotStatement: Riot describes this as a pro-focused passive modification with jungle compensation.

changes.reason: Riot reduced elite-skewed damage and mana efficiency while adding armor growth.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is restraining Ryze while helping some difficult solo-queue matchups.

changes.reason: Vi had been a long-running meta staple and remained durable after item changes.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is reducing durability and early clear reliability.
details: Base AD reduced but growth increased.

changes.reason: Both AD and AP Volibear remained weak despite earlier buffs.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is tuning up both AD and AP builds.

changes.reason: Bard's durability was too high for his mobility and utility.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is targeting Bard's durability after earlier damage reductions.
details: Base armor and armor growth reduced.

changes.reason: Early laning power was reduced while some AP scaling was returned.
changes.riotStatement: Riot explicitly describes these as adjustments aimed at reducing pro skew.
details: Multiple base values and costs reduced or increased.

changes.reason: Ekko had settled into a slightly weak state, particularly in mid.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Ekko has room for power without buffing his Hail of Blades pattern.

changes.reason: Kassadin had not recovered from earlier nerfs.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Q should scale harder and Riftwalk should offer more early agency.

changes.reason: Rageblade-related changes hit Yi especially hard and his melee-carry scaling was weak.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Yi is being buffed back up.

changes.reason: Nautilus had remained near the top of the support meta for most of the year.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says nerfing Nautilus should create more support variety.
details: Q damage reduced at later ranks.

changes.reason: Bot-lane Seraphine remained frustrating and too effective.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is targeting bot Seraphine through E rank-up cooldown.
details: E cooldown no longer decreases with rank.

changes.reason: Syndra overperformed in specific solo-queue settings.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says W and mana breakpoints are being tapped down.

changes.reason: Viego's win rate and player interest had been declining.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says Viego has room for general power and bruiser-build viability.
details: Passive healing gained additional scaling hooks.

changes.reason: A resurrection interaction made Q feel worse, and Q2 damage had room to increase.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is using a QoL fix as an opportunity to give Zaahen some love.
details: Q cooldown behavior improved around resurrection.

changes.reason: Recent item buffs pushed Zeri above her intended power level.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is pulling power from burst and waveclear.

changes.reason: Aurelion Sol came out weaker after the prior mage adjustments.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is giving him a buff, especially to W availability.
details: W cooldown reduced at later ranks.

changes.reason: Recent rune/item nerfs weakened Cho'Gath's early game.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is restoring some early auto-attack damage.

changes.reason: Several indirect buffs had pushed Graves too high.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is softening his snowballing with high-AD builds.

changes.reason: Irelia was too dependent on snowballing and failed to scale into a carry threat.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is improving her carry scaling.
details: W and R AP ratios increased.

changes.reason: Old Statikk-driven attack-speed constraints were no longer needed and AP assassination had room for power.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is restoring a more normal attack-speed baseline and buffing AP ratios.
details: Attack speed ratio increased while growth decreased.
W and RW AP ratios increased.

changes.reason: Top Nasus benefited too much from the new stacking paradigm.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is tapping down top-specific sustain.

changes.reason: Nocturne remained strong across skill levels.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it wants more personal risk around his level-six spike.

changes.reason: Mid Qiyana gained damage while jungle clear efficiency was reduced.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it wants to support jungle Qiyana without leaving mid underwhelming.

changes.reason: Thresh had quietly reached a high win rate and rising play rate.
changes.riotStatement: Riot taps down Flay damage.
details: E active base damage and AP ratio reduced.

changes.reason: Trundle's personal damage had fallen behind his utility.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says his personal clubbing power is too weak.
details: W attack speed increased at ranks 2-5.

changes.reason: Riot prioritized reducing top-lane Vayne power despite small base-stat compensation.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says the goal is to constrain top-lane power more than bot-lane power.

changes.reason: Xerath was slightly too strong in both mid and bot.
changes.riotStatement: Riot calls for a light nerf due to power and regional ban rates.

changes.reason: Yasuo was too snowball-dependent instead of scaling reliably as a carry.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is reducing his critical-strike damage penalty.
details: Critical-strike damage penalty reduced from 10% to 5%.

changes.reason: Yone had a similar snowball-dependence problem to Yasuo.
changes.riotStatement: Riot applies the same crit-scaling improvement to Yone.
details: Critical-strike damage penalty reduced from 10% to 5%.

changes.reason: Azir still needed laning help while Riot monitored his keystone choices.
changes.riotStatement: Riot calls this a moderate laning buff.

changes.reason: Bel'Veth's late-game scaling was rising too sharply after her update.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is making the late game less sharp.
details: R true-form attack-speed curve reduced late.

changes.reason: Support roaming power was reduced while top-lane repeat trading was improved.
changes.riotStatement: Riot explicitly frames this as a role-shifting change rather than a clean buff.
details: Passive shield early value reduced but cooldown improved.
W cooldown and outer-cone damage improved.

changes.reason: Gwen remained slightly weak after earlier nerfs.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is buffing passive sustain.

changes.reason: Rocketbelt changes left Kennen weaker than intended.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is compensating Kennen and rewarding strong ultimate flanks.

changes.reason: Stack generation was shifted to bring top and jungle closer together.
changes.riotStatement: Riot describes this as a role-power adjustment.

changes.reason: Power moved away from early AD-fighter patterns toward tank scaling.
changes.riotStatement: Riot says it is shifting power rather than simply increasing it.
details: Base AD and Q AD ratio reduced.
Mana, regen, tank scaling and monster cap improved.
